title: Verified static artifact reaches production
description:
As an Apricity visitor, I want production to serve the exact static artifact verified by GitHub Actions, so that release quality does not depend on AWS Amplify builds.

Feature: GitHub-built static deployment

Scenario: A successful main build is deployed
Given a successful GitHub CI build for main
When the production deployment runs
Then Amplify receives the exact tested static artifact
And Amplify does not install dependencies or execute the project build.

Scenario: A pull request is evaluated
Given a pull request
When GitHub CI runs
Then it runs the project checks and static build
And it does not deploy to production.
